_meta.provenance: AUTHORED — written by hand to probe known failure modes. NOT openFDA, NOT FAERS, NOT patient data. Numbers computed on this set are development figures for guiding rule changes; they are NOT validation results and must not be reported as extraction performance on real narratives. Cases added in 0.3.0 were drafted by the screenAIr team to exercise the phrases and behaviours the clinical lead approved on 2026-10-04; the case text itself has not yet been reviewed by the clinical lead. The cases added in round 2 of 0.3.0 (design 05 §12) were drafted by the team in the same way and have not been reviewed by the clinical lead either. The cases added in round 3 of 0.3.0 (rules R9-R11, design 05 §13) were drafted by the team in the same way and have not been reviewed by the clinical lead either. The same holds for the cases added in rounds 3b and 3c (design 05 §13.10, §13.11). Cases added in 0.4.0 (register chart): k001 is the clinical lead's own history and physical (chat, 2026-10-11), verbatim, a template with *** placeholders and no patient data; k002-k051 are the 50 rows of the team's chart-text catalogue, drafted by the team on 2026-10-11 to probe the chart-reading failure modes; k052-k065 were drafted by the team on 2026-10-11 to test the release 0.4.7 review fixes (chart pronouns, the conflict rule, whole-word cues); k066-k122 were drafted by the team on 2026-10-11 to test the review round 1 fixes (red flags lowered only by a denial that governs them, lists under a denying line, post cues that close their item, scopeEnd words, exam sub-labels and inline section labels, chart pronouns before a person, negation contractions, a leading "?", length-keeping lowercase). k123-k186 were drafted by the team on 2026-10-11 to test the review round 2 fixes (chart-register red-flag phrases, the held-out cases H01, H06, H09, H11, H18, H20-H22, H24, H25 and H27, treatment-failure wording, chart notation, hedges, report headers, the exam section, and the safety clarification qualifiers). k187-k259 were drafted by the team on 2026-10-11 to test the review round 3 fixes (signs between findings, abbreviations, later list items that hold more than the finding, complement words, the end of a list under a denial, denied clarification qualifiers, label answers that close their label, a second label on a line, and the "/" rule), most of them the round-3 reviewers' own texts. k260-k273 were drafted by the team on 2026-10-12 to test what the clinical lead's sign-off of that day added or changed (the hedge "+/-", the deny cues "not associated with", "not accompanied by" and "neg for", the rf_progressive and rf_asym phrases, no context markers from typed chart text, the clarification qualifiers removed, and the struck rf_orbital phrases). The clinical lead signed off the lexicon rows these cases exercise on 2026-10-12; the cases and their expectations, and the catalogue's own, are team drafts not yet reviewed by the clinical lead.

revisionLog: 0.2.0 — three labels corrected after the first benchmark run disagreed with them and the extractor turned out to be right. Recorded rather than silently amended: a gold set edited to match its system is not a gold set, so every change is listed with its reason.
0.3.0 — 156 utterances and 53 dialogues added for lexicon 0.3.2 (F1 heard, F2 carry-over, F3 vocabulary, F4 yield, text normalization); no 0.2.0 case or label changed.

0.3.0 round 2 (2026-10-04, design 05 §12) — 40 utterances (t001-t040) and 19 dialogues (d054-d072) added for the round-2 rules (R1 carry negation clause-wide, R2 band choice for heard entries, R3a carryExclude, R3b onset guard, R4 digits for durations only, R5 yield after the heard card is answered or skipped), the red-flag and mixed normalize cases, and every trace of the round-1 review, including the disclosed known risks. Six labels changed with the round-2 rules; as for every 0.3.0 label, each is the extractor's output under those rules: u008 and u009 (R4: digits no longer reach the i_days cue "ten days" or the v_count phrase "five episodes"), d010 (R1), d021, d039 and d041 (R3a). Each changed case says so in its note. No 0.2.0 case or label changed. Totals: 196 utterances and 72 dialogues added to the 44 cases of 0.2.0. (The wording of this entry was corrected in round 3, review F8.)

0.3.0 round 3 (2026-10-05, design 05 §13) — 16 utterances (w001-w016) and 13 dialogues (d073-d085) added for the round-3 rules (R9 direct extraction for heard entries: a negated band span, a carryRefuse phrase or disagreeing spans withhold the value, and an utterance whose value was withheld while a band span was present opens no carry-over and closes an open slot of that item; R10 carry: carryExclude phrases count for the negation and disagreement tests, and any negated span refuses the whole reply; R11 a carryExclude phrase counts in direct extraction only in the sentence of the cue), every trace of the round-2 review (F1-F4, ENG-R1-1), the R11 boundary rule and its disclosed exception, and the compound-tens known risk. Four labels changed with the round-3 rules; as for every 0.3.0 label, each is the extractor's output under those rules: t003 and t005 (R9: a negated band span withholds the value) and d069 and d070 (R9: no carry-over opens from an utterance whose value was withheld while a band span was present). Each changed case says so in its note. The notes of t001, t009, t011, t012, t013, y014, d010, d021, d039, d041, d050, d059 and d065 were corrected for the round-3 rules; their labels are unchanged. No 0.2.0 case or label changed. Totals: 212 utterances and 85 dialogues added to the 44 cases of 0.2.0.

0.3.0 round 3b (2026-10-05, design 05 §13.10) — 5 dialogues (d086-d090) added for the yield-only slot: an utterance whose duration is withheld (a negated band span, a carryRefuse phrase or disagreeing spans) arms a slot that keeps the entries yielding to the item yielding but is never carried into, and turns an open slot of the item yield-only with its remaining count instead of closing it; the dialogue format gains the pending form [id, turnsLeft, "yield-only"]. Seven dialogue labels changed with the round-3b rule; as for every 0.3.0 label, each is the extractor's output under those rules: d069, d070, d075, d076, d078 and d079 (the withheld line now arms a yield-only slot; round 3 armed none) and d085 (the open slot turns yield-only instead of closing). Only their pending labels and notes changed; no capture, heard or refusal label changed. Each changed dialogue says so in its note. No utterance case and no 0.2.0 case or label changed. The added dialogues were drafted by the team in the same way as the other 0.3.0 cases and have not been reviewed by the clinical lead. Totals: 212 utterances and 90 dialogues added to the 44 cases of 0.2.0.

0.3.0 round 3c (2026-10-05, design 05 §13.11) — 6 utterances (w017-w022) and 3 dialogues (d091-d093) added for two corrections found by the final pre-deploy review. (1) R11 made removal-only: a carryExclude phrase supplies a value in direct extraction only in a cue sentence (one holding a hit of any of the entry's cue phrases that is not negated and passes the attribution and history gates), and elsewhere it still counts for the negation and disagreement tests and as a stated band, so the entry is withheld and opens only a yield-only slot. Round 3 ignored such a span entirely, which let an overlapping "days at a time" score Over 72 h and let carry-over open after a day range (reviews F-R11-OVER72, ENG-R11-1), and took the cue's sentence from the first-listed cue phrase found only (ENG-R11-2). (2) A yield-only slot of a withheld entry is refreshed with the full carry on each withheld line, instead of keeping its remaining count (review F-3B-REMAINING-COUNT). Labels changed with these rules; as for every 0.3.0 label, each is the extractor's output under them: w013 (now heard, no value; round 3 recorded v 1), d077 (the first line opens only a yield-only slot and the reply is not carried; round 3 carried v 2), d085 and d088 (the converted slot is refreshed), d089 (m_dur now yields on the last line; round 3b recorded m_dur = Under 4 h). The notes of w003, w005, w006, w007, w008 and w009 were corrected; their labels are unchanged. No 0.2.0 case or label changed. The added cases were drafted by the team and have not been reviewed by the clinical lead. Totals: 218 utterances and 93 dialogues added to the 44 cases of 0.2.0.

0.4.0 (2026-10-11, release 0.4.7, lexicon 0.3.3) — the 218 utterances and 93 dialogues of 0.3.0 copied verbatim; 122 chart cases added (k001 the clinical lead's history and physical, k002-k051 the chart-text catalogue, k052-k065 the review-fix cases: chart pronouns, the conflict rule, whole-word cues; k066-k122 the review round 1 cases, both directions of each fix); a supersede table of 7 labels that lexicon 0.3.3 changes (2 of the 44 reference cases: r02, f02; 5 of the 0.3.0 cases: y032, t013, w011, w013, w019; no dialogue step), each with the lead's request or decision it rests on and the rule that causes it. No 0.2.0 or 0.3.0 case or label is edited. Reference case n07 is not superseded: a denied weather trigger and an affirmed meal trigger are different findings of m_trig, so under the conflict rule of the review fixes its 0.2.0 "yes" stands (an earlier draft of this release superseded it). Review round 1: v025 and v042 leave the supersede table, since a negation contraction ("wasn't", "don't") is measured from the "n't" it holds and keeps its 0.3.2 reach, so both keep their 0.3.0 label.

0.4.0 review round 2 (2026-10-11) — chart reading now applies to typed chart text only (opts.chart): a spoken or demo line extracts exactly as in release 0.4.6, so every 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 case and dialogue keeps its label and the supersede table is empty (its 7 rows, r02, f02, y032, t013, w011, w013 and w019, were spoken-register cases; r02's red flag is raised again from speech, as the reference file says). Six chart labels changed with the round-2 rules, each the engine's output and each noted: k001 (no r_normal from the exam section; r_normal added to its expectAbsent), k017 (rf_ssnhl raised and the laterality and onset cards shown; its catalogue row now agrees), k068 ("no relief" is a treatment-failure cue: v_aural yes, removed from its expectAbsent), k079 (the laterality card shows), k081 (m_head 1 after "no improvement") and k121 ("maybe" hedges the nausea; m_nausea added to its expectAbsent). 64 chart cases added (k123-k186). Totals: 186 chart cases.

0.4.0 review round 3 (2026-10-11) — eleven chart labels changed with the round-3 rules, each the engine's output and each noted: k001 and k015 ("not pulsatile" no longer silences the tinnitus-quality card), k070, k074, k075, k099 and k102 (a trigger set aside as uncertain asks), k071 (a qualifier denied by the window across a comma), k027 ("purulent drainage" in a later list item is set aside; its catalogue row no longer agrees), k061 ("since" is a complement word: m_nausea and m_photo set aside) and k104 (a later item with another word is set aside: m_photo, reversing review round 1). 73 chart cases added (k187-k259). Totals: 259 chart cases.

0.4.0 sign-off (2026-10-12) — the clinical lead's decisions applied. Ten chart labels changed, each the engine's output and each noted with the decision it rests on: k001, k006 and k037 (the mask "aural" struck: "aural fullness" reads aura; k001 then states and denies aura, a conflict card; k006 and k037 record m_aura yes and drop it from expectAbsent, their catalogue rows no longer agreeing), k004 (the rf_focal phrase "facial numbness" struck: n_burn set aside), k126, k166 and k223 (rf_orbital and rf_vision phrases struck: no flag), k035 and k243 (D8: typed chart text sets no context marker: c_dismiss, c_dur) and k162 (D8: "mucosal thickening" no longer resolves the scan-report trigger). 14 chart cases added (k260-k273). The supersede table gives five 0.2.0 / 0.3.0 case outputs that D9 (chart reading for spoken lines too) changes: e16, r02, f02, t007 and w019; no dialogue step changes. The 0.3.0 file is unchanged (byte for byte). Totals: 273 chart cases, 5 superseded labels.
_meta.labels030: Each 0.3.0 label is what lexicon 0.3.2 with the screenAIr 0.4.1 extractor (round 2, round 3, round 3b and round 3c rules included) returns: the 0.3.0 labels are the 0.3.2 extractor's own output (regression snapshot); P/R/F1 on them is tautological, not a measurement. Known false positives, false suppressions and misses are labelled as the rule behaves and carry a note, as z02 and z04 do in 0.2.0. Labels are development data, not ground truth for performance claims.
_meta.labels040: A 0.2.0 or 0.3.0 case or dialogue keeps its label unless the supersede table gives a 0.4.0 one (five cases since the lead's decision D9 of 2026-10-12, which reads spoken lines with chart reading too; review round 2 had kept chart reading to typed chart text). A chart case's expect, expectHeard, expectClarify and expectEvidence are what lexicon 0.3.3 with the screenAIr 0.4.7 extractor returns reading it as typed chart text (opts.chart) (a regression snapshot; P/R/F1 on them is tautological, not a measurement); expectAbsent lists the ids the team's draft expectation says must not be captured; catalogue keeps the catalogue's own draft expectation verbatim and whether the 0.3.3 output agrees with it (why, when it does not). Every 0.4.0 label is a DRAFT test expectation (labelStatus draft) awaiting the clinical lead's review.

format.cases: Run with extract(lexicon, text, {includeHeard: true}), unsuppressed. expect: the item, ctx and red-flag [id, value] pairs (a set). expectHeard: the heard ids (a set; [] when absent).
format.dialogues: turns: [speaker, text], speaker pt (patient) or md (physician). Patient turns run through extractInContext(lexicon, text, pending) in order, keeping the returned pending; md turns are passed over and leave pending untouched, as in the Scribe. Also as in the Scribe (round 2, R5): a heard capture of an item already answered is dropped, and while the pending item is answered the slot is still passed, with {carry: false}, and the returned pending is kept. steps[k] labels turn k: null for an md turn, else {captures: [id, value] or [id, value, "carry"], in engine order; heard: heard ids; pending: [id, turnsLeft] after the turn, or [id, turnsLeft, "yield-only"] for a yield-only slot (round 3b: it counts as pending for yieldTo and is consumed and expires like any slot, but no value is ever carried into it), or null; refused: the carry refusal code or null}. As in the Scribe, the returned pending is kept and passed whole, yieldOnly included.
format.chartCases: register chart. Run with extract(lexicon, text, {includeHeard: true, chart: true}) (typed chart text, as the Scribe reads it), unsuppressed: expect and expectHeard as for cases; expectAbsent: ids with no unsuppressed capture at all (no value, no heard, no red flag); expectClarify: clarifyCues(lexicon, text, {chart: true}) as [reason, id] in text order; expectEvidence (k001, k122): each captured id's evidence, the text of its clause; catalogue (k002-k051): {row, category, expected (the catalogue's draft, verbatim), agrees, why?}; note (k001, k015, k052-k273): what the case shows.
format.supersede: {id, set ("0.2.0": the reference file; "0.3.0"), kind ("case" | "dialogue-step", with step), was (the label as written, which must still be the file's), now (the 0.4.0 label), cites (the lead's request of 2026-10-11 or decision it rests on), rule (what causes the change), status, flag? (a point for the lead)}. Scoring uses now in place of was. Since the lead's decision D9 of 2026-10-12 (chart reading for spoken lines too) it holds the five 0.2.0 / 0.3.0 case outputs lexicon 0.3.3 changes; a row cites the lead's request of 2026-10-11, a decision of the lead's (decisions.…) or the sign-off of 2026-10-12.
